claim: On NAS-Bench architecture ranking, the RLM attains average Kendall tau 0.461, outperforming Arch2Vec 0.212 and CATE 0.238 and matching a GNN baseline 0.429.

routes.name: Exact source and protocol reconstruction
routes.interpretation: Treat Table 4 as a five-space full-target-domain Kendall tau-b comparison under the FLAN few-shot protocol.
routes.method: Hash the paper HTML, reconstruct Table 4 arithmetic, and trace the inherited FLAN protocol: 1024 source rows, 16 target shots for four spaces, 100 for DARTS, then evaluate the remaining target space.
routes.control: Recompute the RLM mean from all five displayed cells and require 0.4612 rounding to 0.461.
routes.result: Protocol and arithmetic verified, but two target-specific checkpoints and every train/evaluation row manifest are unavailable.

routes.name: Independent metric correction on retained predictions
routes.interpretation: Test whether the prior Spearman-only evidence can directly answer the Kendall component without treating it as target-specific Table 4 evidence.
routes.method: Recompute Kendall tau-b with SciPy and an independent pair counter on 512 retained ENAS and NASNet predictions from the unified base checkpoint.
routes.control: Two hundred shuffled-target permutations must fail the GNN threshold.
routes.result: ENAS tau-b 0.172070 and NASNet tau-b 0.138758; implementations agree exactly and controls fail acceptance. The checkpoint is the wrong model for Table 4.

routes.name: Direct released target-checkpoint execution
routes.interpretation: Test the released target-specific implementation path and calibrate faithful CPU inference without promoting a bounded sample to paper-scale evidence.
routes.method: Run pinned DARTS checkpoint revision 7aedf5c on 16 deterministic released GraphArch rows with eight stochastic draws and median aggregation.
routes.control: Record 128 raw draws, independently recompute medians and Kendall pairs, and apply 200 target permutations.
routes.result: End-to-end path passed: tau-b 0.55 on n=16, 192.011 s inference, 64 CPUs allocated. The rows are not the full remaining target domain and unknown fine-tuning rows cannot be excluded.

routes.name: Dedicated exact-claim falsification attempt
routes.interpretation: Seek an assumption-satisfying counterexample to the exact five-space average and comparator statement, not a failed reproduction or a nearby model.
routes.method: Require target-specific RLM predictions for NASNet, Amoeba, PNAS, ENAS, and DARTS over every remaining target-domain row after excluding the exact few-shot rows; recompute five tau-b values and their mean independently.
routes.control: Reject the unified-base ENAS/NASNet diagnostics and the 16-row DARTS calibration as counterexamples because they violate the model or evaluation-domain assumptions.
routes.result: No valid counterexample can be constructed: ENAS and NASNet target-specific checkpoints are absent and all five row manifests are absent. Failure to access those artifacts is not falsification.
